chapter: Morrison's, the Slipper and leaving music
title: Playing concerts at Morrison's cafeteria while working in the repair department
summary: He played twice-daily concerts at Morrison's and pit work at the Capitol Theater while holding a repair-department job; digression on Al Galador.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Well, that's... Yeah. Then let me go back a little while to Morrison's end. When did you play at Morrison's?

I was waking to the Whirlands. You know, repair department. I had a charge of repair department. And while I was there, Morrison wanted to go over and play a dinner dance. Well, not dance. I mean, just a dinner concert. Yeah. And he liked it. Mm-hmm. So, we saw... I'd make one at 12, and then I'd go back at 5 and make one. But I played two concerts a day in my repair department. Mm-hmm. And you were also at that time playing a theater version. Yeah, sang a... Sang a theater? I was just replacing... You know, playing a pit. Yeah, playing a pit, but I was just... I was just replacing a little... What's his name again? This was from London, wasn't it? He thought it was a regular show. Playing a pit. It's a regular show.
You know who was just here in town? Huh? About a week was Al Galador. Do you remember him?
I didn't know what he said.
He left town in... Galador. He left town in about 35. He played at the Orpheum for a long time. Yeah. With Joe Fulco. Mm-hmm. I thought you might remember him.
No, I don't really know Fulco. Yeah, he and...
He and Boris... Howard Glories were in the band, I think, and... Mike Kaplan. You know Mike Kaplan? Yeah, I don't know Mike Kaplan.
I know him. I don't know him.
Anyway, he played at... At Morrison's. Yeah.
